summary: Sister of John T. Petriello, born in Pennsylvania in 1934; John's great-aunt.
bio: Ann Marie Petriello was born in Pennsylvania in 1934, a sister of John T. Petriello, which makes her John's great-aunt. In 1950 she was living at Dunmore, Lackawanna, Pennsylvania. The 2024 obituary of John T. Petriello Jr. mentions a cousin Ann Marie, though whether this is the same woman is unclear.

round5: Ann Marie Petriello, b. about 1934, is the same woman as M0003 'Ann Marie Genello' (see that file for the full evidence). In April 1940 she was 6, living at 1028 Bunker Hill Street, Scranton, with her parents James and Mollie and her brother John ([R4-S2]). Her brother John T. Petriello Sr.'s 2025 obituary names her as 'his sister Ann Marie Genello' ([R4-S1]). She married Anthony 'Zitzer' Genello about 1955-56 and was widowed in February 2024 ([R4-S3]).
